items.headline: Injective CEO: US $INJ ETFs May Land Before 2027
items.summary: Injective CEO Eric Chen says US-listed $INJ ETFs could arrive sooner than 2027, a potential early catalyst for the mid-cap altcoin.

items.headline: $PENDLE Collateral Gets LlamaRisk Agents on Plasma
items.summary: Aave activated LlamaRisk agents to manage $PENDLE collateral on Plasma, a fresh DeFi risk-management use case for the growing yield token.

items.headline: $COMP Governance Strains: Treasury Delay & Veto Vote
items.summary: Compound is voting on treasury delays and veto powers as DeFi governance tensions rise, putting $COMP holders on alert.

items.headline: $SOL Tops DeFi Venues for Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: Solana has emerged as the leading DeFi venue for tokenized stock trading, a notable ecosystem milestone for $SOL.

items.headline: $AAVE Hikes GHO Borrow Rates to Rescue Pools
items.summary: Aave raised GHO borrowing rates to replenish drained stablecoin liquidity, a sign of stress and active risk response around $AAVE.
